item.title: Scientists discover lemon-shaped exoplanet
item.description: Scientists have discovered a peculiar, lemon-shaped exoplanet, PSR J2322-2650b, that is challenging current understanding of how planets form. The planet has extreme physical and atmospheric properties unlike anything seen before. Researchers believe the planet’s atmosphere may be filled with soot-like clouds, and deep within its interior, carbon could clump into solid crystals—possibly even forming diamonds. […]
